data.name: Italian Chicken and Spinach Skillet
data.description: Tender seared chicken breast fillets simmer in a vibrant garlic, tomato, and baby spinach pan sauce infused with fragrant Italian herbs and finished with melted parmesan.

not_suitable_for: Individuals with dairy allergies or severe lactose intolerance (contains parmesan cheese)

items.name: chicken breast
items.notes: 100% edible yield; purchase 600g boneless skinless breast
substitutions: boneless skinless chicken thighs (adjusted cooking time)

instructions.text: Pat the chicken breasts dry with paper towels on a dedicated raw poultry cutting board, then slice them horizontally into four cutlets of even thickness. Wash hands and sanitize knives and cutting surfaces immediately to prevent cross-contamination.
tips: Even cutlets ensure all pieces reach the safe target temperature simultaneously.

instructions.text: Season both sides of the chicken cutlets evenly with 3 grams of the salt, black pepper, dried oregano, and garlic powder.
Set the large skillet over medium-high heat at 190°C (375°F) and add 15 ml of olive oil, tilting the pan to coat the bottom evenly until the oil shimmers.

doneness_cues.visual: oil shimmers and flows like water when swirled

instructions.text: Place the seasoned chicken cutlets into the hot skillet in a single layer using tongs. Sear undisturbed for 4 to 5 minutes until deep golden brown on the bottom.

doneness_cues.visual: edges turn opaque and undersides show a rich golden crust
doneness_cues.tactile: cutlets release cleanly from the pan without sticking

tips: Do not move the cutlets during the first 3 minutes to allow proper crust formation.

instructions.text: Turn the cutlets over using tongs and cook the second side for 3 to 4 minutes until an instant-read meat thermometer inserted into the thickest part reads at least 74°C (165°F).

doneness_cues.visual: juices run clear without traces of pink

instructions.text: Transfer the cooked chicken from the skillet onto a clean plate to rest while preparing the sauce.

Lower the skillet heat to medium at 160°C (320°F). Add the remaining 15 ml of olive oil, the minced garlic, and the halved cherry tomatoes, sautéing for 2 minutes until the garlic is fragrant and the tomato skins soften.

doneness_cues.visual: garlic is pale blonde and tomatoes begin to collapse
doneness_cues.tactile: tomatoes yield slightly when pressed with a wooden spoon

instructions.text: Pour the chicken broth into the skillet and scrape up all browned bits from the pan bottom using a wooden spoon. Simmer for 2 minutes to reduce slightly.

doneness_cues.visual: liquid bubbles vigorously and pan bottom is free of stuck residue

instructions.text: Add the baby spinach and the remaining 2 grams of salt to the skillet. Toss continuously with the wooden spoon for 2 minutes until the spinach collapses into a glossy dark green tangle.

doneness_cues.visual: spinach is fully wilted and glossy bright green

instructions.text: Stir in the fresh lemon juice, return the rested chicken cutlets and any accumulated plate juices into the skillet, and scatter the grated parmesan cheese across the top.
Remove the skillet from heat and spoon the warm spinach, burst cherry tomatoes, and pan sauce over each cutlet to serve immediately.
